matching_target_resume.description: POST /operator/recovery on separate authenticated Service Auth operator gateway only. JSON envelope <=65536 UTF-8 bytes. write-chunk uses application/octet-stream and X-CFHub-Recovery-Control: unpadded base64url canonical JSON of this same envelope (<=8192 ASCII bytes). Stream <=1MiB; measure actual bytes and match declared byte_size and SHA256. No Content-Length trust. Read chunk JSON index returns binary plus X-CFHub-Recovery-Chunk encoding closed {capture_id,index,sha256,byte_size}, same header bound. No arbitrary SQL, destination, table or object key.

DeploymentConfig.title: CF Agent Hub deployment configuration contract revision 0.2
DeploymentConfig.description: Shape validation is necessary, never authorization. Semantic validation additionally requires exact issuer/subject grants, stable actor/hash mappings, one policy and callback per workspace, immutable unique catalog mappings, client_id=audience, safe operator-approved notification host/path, and <=90-day credential expiry at provisioning. Unknown fields fail with field paths and no values.
